source_freeze_contract.policy: Reuse the exact original committed J binding and source910ba without edits. Candidate/runtime/test hashes, prior failed-attempt receipts, original driver bytes and diagnostic audit must match before the new attempt is claimed. No branch-tip source resolution.
source_freeze_contract.runtime_scope: J is the separately proposed bounded FTS hidden-rank probe with the exact historical SQL fallback on boundary ties, built on the integrated I+T1 runtime. This driver does not assert its correctness or speed before measurement.

prior_evidence: All I and J1 evidence remains independent and unchanged, including both failed J1 preflight and the artificial diagnostic summary failure. J1 ran zero profile/paired calls. J2 uses new snapshots, one profile and one paired sequence under the original gates, with no outcome-based repetition selection.

correctness.criterion: Freeze exact module files at the J source commit. Before corpus calls, run every test in these thirteen modules; verify suite.countTestCases equals result.testsRun and zero failures/errors/skips. The first nine are the previously executed 101-fixture scope; do not invent a new hardcoded total.
correctness.environment: One ubuntu-24.04 / Python3.12 hosted VM; same pinned mcp1.30.0, pydantic2.14.3, tiktoken0.12.0 and regex2026.11.9 for both runtimes. Capture actual Python/SQLite/dependency/binary/tokenizer-cache identities before measurement.
correctness.isolation: First export exact910ba src/tests into a dedicated correctness directory and verify every frozen runtime/test file and runtime aggregate. Save started intent. Run the same13-module suite once, retain every file afterward, capture added/missing/changed full source inventory and archive the complete correctness export losslessly. Missing/changed bound files or unknown added Python/non-bytecode files fail before measurement. Generated bytecode is explicitly recorded only in this never-measured directory; it is never deleted or excluded from the measurement guard.
correctness.measurement_export: After correctness and its saved inventory audit pass, independently export fresh exact baseline692fb and candidate910ba src/tests into separate measurement directories. Recheck the complete file inventory, no symlinks and aggregate runtime SHA before profile and every paired stage. An extra pyc or unknown .py in either measurement export fails the complete guard. Never import or execute measurement helpers from the correctness export.
correctness.archive: Commit correctness-export.tar.gz and its full manifest/hash before corpus preparation. It contains only the repository source/tests and artificial fixture residue, never a downloaded development corpus or development DB. Preserve negative receipts and available partial files without retries.

data.policy: Only previously used old regression cohorts and exactly registered selections/seeds. No fresh selector, model, comparison engine or evaluator is invoked.

profile.method: Read only the nine exact small manifest/cell objects through git show; validate every compressed size/SHA256 and decompressed SHA256. Run one fresh candidate profile using the unchanged helper. Preserve original report bytes losslessly as gzip with raw and compressed hashes. Verify all eight cell axes, complete orders, dataset hashes and all 4732 full non-timing payload digests against saved v032/C2 references. Publish output and audit before paired timing; any incomplete profile or mismatch stops the paired phase.
profile.preservation: All instrumented profiler rows and negative outcomes remain present. Summary profile times identify code paths only; no historical profile latency or profiler time is used to infer speed.

snapshots: Before profile/timing, build each new paired source database exactly once with released v032 and the frozen old loader. Record immutable DB bytes, sizes, logical table digests and query selection. Both runtimes copy those same snapshots to unique worker directories; the profile helper independently creates its own candidate databases, exactly as before. No historical database hash is substituted, no completed worker DB is reused. Controller allocation during snapshot hashing is not a formal memory-resource measurement.

paired.query_selection: Same 128 old IDs per cohort; independently recompute selection and require equality with the frozen original binding.
paired.query_order: random.Random(91261 + round*1009 + configuration_index).shuffle; original AB/BA order.
paired.audit: All eight workers, 4096 observations, 2048 full non-timing payload pairs, exact query/configuration order, finite timings, per-round and pooled p50/p95/mean, p95 geometric change, and every cell whose p50 or p95 regresses beyond5%. No selection of favorable repetitions.

durability.policy: Only run_attempt1 on ci/v033-candidate-j-development-2; reject existing result/state. Before claim verify exact source binding, old failure directory/receipts, original driver/scope and saved diagnostic audit. Preserve correctness intent/outcome/archive, fresh source inventories, new DB binding, profile intent/output/audit and each worker intent/result in verified remote commits. Benchmark subprocesses explicitly retain PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. No automatic replay or write retry.
durability.publication: Non-force expected-head verification. After one push verify exact new remote commit. On refusal or ambiguity, stop without automatic retry; retain failure marker and artifacts. No source database or corpus plaintext is published.
durability.failure: Keep all original receipts, failed/incomplete stages, available cell-granularity partial JSON and logs. Gzip conversion is lossless with exact uncompressed checksum. Workflow always preservation never invokes retrieval or replays a stage.

formal_and_release: No original numerical threshold is changed: the14-cell/66248-call formal performance requirements, full-payload contracts, resource review, historical lexical/Q2 compatibility, planned fresh quality validation and release verification remain separate mandatory steps. This development run alone cannot certify release readiness or competitor superiority.

prior_attempt.zero_call_boundary: The pinned result directory has exactly the seven listed files and no profile intent/output or paired worker intent/output. In the unchanged original driver the failing guard precedes profile.intent. The workflow-outcome retrieval_calls field is preservation-only, not itself a measurement counter.
prior_attempt.policy: Keep the original failure, raw receipts and new artificial diagnostic negative outcome. This independent attempt does not resume or relabel attempt1; no timing or corpus outcome was available for selection.

source_inventory_diagnostic.finding: The unchanged 161-test suite leaves all18 frozen source files unchanged, but the official MCP case's two explicitly filtered subprocess environments omit PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE and create12 valid .pyc files. A distinct ordinary CLI event inherits1. The diagnostic summary mistakenly included that CLI event in its MCP predicate; the saved-only audit corrects the classification without rerunning anything.
source_inventory_diagnostic.limits: This reproduces the mechanism in a new artificial run. The actual file inventory of the failed development1 VM was not saved and cannot be retrospectively reconstructed.
